title: Update prompt reference from CLAUDE.md to AGENTS.md
harness_change: Edits the Claude-routed system prompt (anthropic.txt). The 'VERY IMPORTANT: run lint/typecheck when done' instruction now points to AGENTS.md instead of CLAUDE.md as the place to record those commands. No code change.

title: feat: add more ignore patterns to the ls tool
harness_change: Extends IGNORE_PATTERNS in the ls (list) tool with .coverage, coverage/, vendor/, tmp/, temp/, .cache/, cache/, logs/, .venv/, venv/ and env/. Directory listings returned to the model now omit those trees, which shrinks output and changes what the agent sees.

title: Standardize parameter description references in Edit and MultiEdit tools
harness_change: The edit, multiedit and edit.txt descriptions referred to old_string/new_string/replace_all while the zod schema used camelCase. This PR rewrites every reference in the tool descriptions to oldString/newString/replaceAll, so the model-facing tool definition matches the schema (PR targets GPT-4.1 parameter confusion).

title: feat: pass mode into task tool
harness_change: The task tool used to spawn every subagent session in 'build' mode. It now passes the parent message's mode, and assistant messages record their mode (with a storage migration that backfills 'build'). Subagents therefore get the same tool and permission set as the calling mode.

title: add support for lsp workspace/didChangeConfiguration
harness_change: When a language server has initialization options, which the built-in TypeScript server does, the client now answers workspace/configuration with them and sends workspace/didChangeConfiguration after init. This can change the diagnostics servers report back into edit/write tool results.

title: tweak: update ls tool to use rg
harness_change: The ls tool's file enumeration moved from a Bun.Glob('**/*') scan with substring ignores to Ripgrep.files with negated globs and the same LIMIT. Ripgrep honors .gitignore and hidden-file rules, so listings shown to the model differ in content and ordering.

title: feat: allow read tool to handle images
harness_change: Adds model modalities to provider metadata. When the active model supports image input, read on an image file now returns the image as a file attachment; before, it threw 'Use a different tool to process images'. Non-image models still get an error.

title: fix: adjust list tool prompt to handle cwd better
harness_change: Rewrites the ls tool description from 'path must be an absolute path, not a relative path' to 'path must be absolute; omit it to use the current workspace directory'. Only the prompt text changes.

title: feat: retry parts
harness_change: Sets the AI SDK maxRetries to 0 for the main loop and compaction and adds a harness-level retry loop. Retryable API errors are recorded as 'retry' message parts and retried up to 10 times with SessionRetry backoff delays. This changes when and how failed model calls are retried mid-turn.

title: Simplify directory tree output for prompts
harness_change: The environment section of the system prompt used to include a <files> tree of up to 200 entries. It now includes a <directories> block with a flat breadth-first list of directory paths only, limited to 50. This shrinks and restructures the initial repository context the model gets.

title: tweak: adjust task tool description/input to alleviate tool call failures that sometimes occured w/ gpt models
harness_change: Renames session_id to task_id with a longer description saying to set it only when resuming. The task tool's output format changes to 'task_id: ... (for resuming...)' followed by <task_result>...</task_result>, and the task.txt wording on fresh context vs. resume is updated.

title: feat: adjust read tool so that it can handle dirs too
harness_change: read now stats the path. For a directory it returns a sorted entry listing with offset/limit paging; files are wrapped in <path>, <type> and <content> tags. edit.txt is updated to match the new read output and error wording.

title: tweak: make read tool offset 1 indexed instead of 0 to avoid confusion that could be caused by line #s being 1 based
harness_change: Changes read's offset from 0-based to 1-based: the default is 1, offset < 1 raises an error, and out-of-range offsets error. @file line ranges in prompts are mapped the same way, and read.txt documents the 1-indexed offset.

title: tweak: tool outputs to be more llm friendly
harness_change: Rewords edit errors ('Could not find oldString in the file. It must match exactly, including whitespace...', 'No changes to apply...'). Glob and grep truncation notices now state how many results are shown and hidden. grep's header reports the total match count rather than the truncated count.

title: feat(tool): return image attachments from webfetch
harness_change: When the HTTP response content-type is an image (excluding SVG), webfetch returns 'Image fetched successfully' plus a base64 data-URL file attachment that the model can view. Before, all bodies were decoded as text.

title: tweak: adjust way skills are presented to agent to increase likelyhood of skill invocations.
harness_change: Adds SystemPrompt.skills(), injected between the environment and instruction blocks. It explains skills, tells the model to use the skill tool, and lists available skills (or says none are available). The environment block also adds the worktree root path. The system prompt changes even when no skills exist.

title: tweak: adjust skill presentation to be a little less token heavy
harness_change: Skill.fmt gains a verbose option: the system prompt uses the XML <available_skills> form and the skill tool description uses a compact '## Available Skills' bullet list. This lowers tokens in the tool definition. With zero skills, both still say 'No skills are currently available.'

title: tweak: remove unnecessary parts from the fallback system prompt
harness_change: Renames qwen.txt to default.txt as the fallback prompt for models without a dedicated prompt. Removes the two 'IMPORTANT: Refuse to write code... that may be used maliciously' paragraphs and keeps a softer 'think about what the code is supposed to do'. Only models routed to the fallback prompt are affected.

title: tweak: only spawn lsp servers for files in current instance (or cwd if instance is global)
harness_change: LSP.getClients now returns no clients for files outside the instance directory (or cwd for a global instance). Edits and reads of files outside the project no longer start language servers or produce diagnostics for the model.

title: tweak: add newline between <content> and first line of read tool output to prevent confusion
harness_change: Changes the read tool's output header from '<content>1: ...' to '<content>' followed by a newline and then '1: ...'. This is a formatting change to every file read the model sees, meant to stop the tag from being confused with line 1.

title: improve bash timeout retry hint
harness_change: Extends the <bash_metadata> timeout line to say that if the command is expected to take longer and is not waiting for interactive input, the model can retry with a larger timeout, and should avoid blind retries otherwise. This changes the agent's recovery guidance after timeouts.

title: feat: support pull diagnostics in the LSP client (C#, Kotlin, etc)
harness_change: Adds textDocument/diagnostic and workspace/diagnostic pull support, capability registration and wait timeouts (5s document, 10s full, 3s per request). edit, write and apply_patch now call touchFile(file, 'document'). Diagnostics for pull-only servers (Roslyn/C#, Kotlin) now reach the model, and wait timing changes for others.

title: tweak: adjust order of system prompt instructions: Global, Project, Skills
harness_change: In the system prompt, the skills block moves from before the AGENTS.md/instruction files to after them. Global instruction files are now added before project ones. Content is unchanged; only ordering and precedence position change.

title: Preapprove agent tmp directory access
harness_change: Creates <os tmpdir>/opencode, adds it to the external_directory whitelist for agents, and adds a line to bash.txt: 'Use ${tmp} for temporary work outside the workspace. This directory is pre-approved.' Headless runs can now use that tmp directory without permission prompts or rejections.

title: tweak: allow read tool to accept offset of 0
harness_change: Removes the 'offset must be greater than or equal to 1' failure. An offset of 0 (or other falsy values) now falls back to 1, so 0-based reads by the model succeed instead of costing a failed tool call.

title: core: reduce prompts for shell, todowrite, and task tools
harness_change: Removes the long git commit/PR protocol from shell.txt, shrinks todowrite.txt from about 211 lines to a short description, trims task.txt usage notes, and drops the terse-answer examples from default.txt. This greatly reduces tool-definition tokens; the body argues modern models don't need the detail.
